introducedTypeRegression.cause: Bun expect.toBe inferred ModelsDev.Provider types are not assignable from widened imported JSON literals
introducedTypeRegression.proposedFix: Compare object identity as a boolean via Object.is, without an unsafe Provider cast; identity test does not assert catalog schema validity

remainingTestFailures: ProjectV2.resolve > returns global for non-git directory
ProjectCopy > refresh ignores existing directories that are no longer git checkouts
Snapshot > treats capture outside Git as unavailable
pendingFixes.cause: Git.repo.discover uses FSUtil.up to select an ancestor .git, then runs rev-parse with cwd at that ancestor. GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES set in preload cannot constrain that earlier filesystem walk.
pendingFixes.proposedBoundaryWork: Enforce an explicit discovery boundary before the filesystem walk. Preserve ordinary nested and linked worktree discovery; add deterministic ancestor-ceiling fixtures. Do not delete or alter the user's home .git.
